verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents spend-related APIs that feed accounting workflows. The Card Expenses API retrieves approved card expenses and marks them as synced after ingestion into an ERP or accounting system, and the Bills API creates and manages vendor invoices, with reconciliation positioned under Spend. However, nothing in the evidence shows a dedicated accounting-data API for ledger entries, chart of accounts, journal entries or accounting-category mapping, so the story is only partly covered. Missing for 10: a dedicated accounting/ledger data API, documented management of accounting fields such as GL codes and tax codes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
